newsitem.title: ESTONIA: PROFIT-TAKING HITS HANSA, HOIU SHARES.
newsitem.headline: PROFIT-TAKING HITS HANSA, HOIU SHARES.

text.p: * Total morning trade 16 million kroons.
* Talse index down 0.72 percent to 303.25.
* Hoiupank most active on 5.9 mln kroons, lower at
170.00/171.00 kroons vs 172.50 kroons.
* Hansapank was lower with 3.2 mln kroons traded
at a spread of 169.50/170.00 vs 171.25 kroons.
* Dealers said that investors were taking profits in
Hansapank and Hoiupank after strong rallies last week.
(A complete report follows)
(See index on stock exchange web site:
http://www.tse.ee/online/total.htm)
Profit-taking hit Hansapank and
Hoiupank on Monday after last week's rally pushed Estonian
shares to record highs.
Hansa was lower at a spread of 169.50/170.00 compared to
171.25 kroons and Hoiu was at 170.00/171.00 kroons compared to
172.50 kroons. Both shares rose over ten percent last week on
the strength og their six-month results.
Dealers added the selling pressure was strong and closing
prices were seen lower compared to Friday.
Farmaatsiatehas was higher at 124.60/125.75 compared to
124.75 kroons in trade of 1.8 million kroons as the market was
waiting for its half-year results, dealers said.
On the free market, Norma was most active in
trade of one million kroons to be traded lower at 79/80.10
compared to 79 kroons.
Kulmhoone, the ice-cream producer which announced its
six-month profit figure and raised its 1997 profit forecast,
traded 884,000 kroons in a spread of 25/27.50 compared to 26.50
kroons.
-- Eva Palu, Tallinn newsroom, +372 6209 201,
reuters@reuters.ee
